details: CONFIRMED by running the check with a PATH whose first git links to /usr/bin/git. git_first_problem compares the raw
path from shutil.which with APPLE_GIT_LAUNCHER; the design asked for the resolved path. A doctor warning only, nothing
breaks, so LOW; the fix is one call. Size: 5 agent minutes.
evidence: ('git first on PATH is the real git', True, '')
failing_case: PATH starts with a folder whose `git` is a symlink to /usr/bin/git (Apple's launcher). shutil.which gives the link's
path, which is not "/usr/bin/git", and `git --exec-path` prints the developer tools' existing helper folder, so
git_first_check() returns ("git first on PATH is the real git", True, ""). Every git start still goes through the
launcher (20.9 ms against 6.6 ms). It should be not ok and name docs/macos.md section 1; the design (section 3 point 2)
says "not ok when the first git on PATH resolves to /usr/bin/git".
fix_hint: In git_first_problem compare os.path.realpath(git) with APPLE_GIT_LAUNCHER (or pass the resolved path from
git_first_check), and add the symlink case to GitFirstOnPath.
pass_cases: - first git on PATH is a symlink to /usr/bin/git: (name, False, detail naming "docs/macos.md section 1")
- first git is /usr/bin/git itself: not ok, as today
- first git is a link to Xcode's usr/bin/git with an existing --exec-path folder (this Mac's ~/.local/bin/git): ok
- a fake git whose --exec-path folder is missing: not ok, as today
reason: tests/test_installer_doctor.py:70 test_a_symlink_to_the_launcher_is_not_ok passes at head, fails on the old code; existing launcher, missing exec-path, real git and Linux cases in the same class pass. lib/relay_setup.py:1190 compares realpaths.
findings.summary: doctor calls a git on PATH that is a link to Apple's launcher "the real git"
